hints.title: Combinatorial Stars and Bars
hints.text: Choosing k segments that can share endpoints can be transformed into choosing distinct endpoints.

hints.title: Equivalent Combination Formulation
hints.text: Allowing consecutive segments to share endpoints turns the problem into choosing 2k elements from n + k - 1 elements.

hints.title: Compute Binomial Coefficient Modulo 10^9+7
hints.text: Compute comb(n + k - 1, 2 * k) modulo 10^9 + 7 using multiplicative formula or dynamic programming.

hints.title: Full Implementation
hints.text:
```python
import math

class Solution:
    def numberOfSets(self, n: int, k: int) -> int:
        MOD = 10**9 + 7
        return math.comb(n + k - 1, 2 * k) % MOD
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Standard 2D dynamic programming takes O(n * k) with prefix sums, whereas combination runs in O(k).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Combinatorial closed form solves in O(k) multiplications and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize how sharing endpoints allows the stars-and-bars translation to comb(n + k - 1, 2k).
